reference_scope: Every actual accepted state and element, exact real-DOF scatter; fixed-lift b_in/max(abs(b_in)), deltaR=0; inherited signed-body/holding projections
qualification: Only accepted states of the declared coarse square peak-.5 cycle under unchanged mathematical gates; no rejected-trial, pressure, clamp, H2/H3, HF5 or all-column qualification

first_force_range_input.scope: First recorded rejected trial input only; no reevaluation or reference qualification
